answer_text:
Let

\[
N=(x+2y)\sqrt{x+y-xy}+(y+2z)\sqrt{y+z-yz}+(z+2x)\sqrt{z+x-zx},
\]
\[
D=xy+yz+zx.
\]

For \(a,b\in(0,1]\),

\[
0\le a+b-ab=1-(1-a)(1-b)\le 1,
\]

so \(\sqrt{a+b-ab}\ge a+b-ab\). Therefore

\[
N\ge (x+2y)(x+y-xy)+(y+2z)(y+z-yz)+(z+2x)(z+x-zx).
\]

Now expand the right-hand side:

\[
\begin{aligned}
&(x+2y)(x+y-xy)+(y+2z)(y+z-yz)+(z+2x)(z+x-zx)\\
&=3(x^2+y^2+z^2)+3(xy+yz+zx)\\
&\qquad -x^2y-y^2z-z^2x-2xy^2-2yz^2-2zx^2.
\end{aligned}
\]

Subtracting \(3(xy+yz+zx)\), we get

\[
\begin{aligned}
&\sum_{\text{cyc}}(x+2y)(x+y-xy)-3(xy+yz+zx)\\
&=x^2(3-y-2z)+y^2(3-z-2x)+z^2(3-x-2y).
\end{aligned}
\]

Since \(0<x,y,z\le 1\),

\[
3-y-2z\ge 0,\quad 3-z-2x\ge 0,\quad 3-x-2y\ge 0.
\]

Hence

\[
N\ge 3(xy+yz+zx)=3D.
\]

Thus

\[
A=\frac ND\ge 3.
\]
